narrative.overview: A calm, premium recording studio in the corner of your screen: warm-dark surfaces, generous rounding, soft shadows, and one live coral energy that only appears where sound and action happen. An Operate surface that stays quiet and scannable and lets the text be the hero. Ships both a warm-dark and a warm-light theme from the same tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-dark-first, with a matching warm-light theme from one token set.
Coral is the one energy color; aqua means success only.
Big soft rounding (16-22px) and diffuse shadows.
IBM Plex Sans throughout, bundled and offline; mono only for numbers.
Quiet by default - the hero recording card is the one loud surface.

rules.name: The One Energy Rule
rules.body: Coral is the only energy color and covers <=10% of a screen.

rules.name: The Aqua-Means-Done Rule
rules.body: Aqua appears only on success/completion, never as decoration.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every changing number renders in tabular mono.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Prefer tonal layering over borders; shadows stay soft and diffuse.

dos: Do keep coral scarce - record button, primary action, live audio, logo.
Do reserve aqua strictly for success/completion.
Do render every changing number in tabular mono.
Do use soft diffuse shadows and tonal layering; rounding 12-22px.
Do keep both themes in sync from the shared token set.
donts: Don't introduce a second brand color or use aqua decoratively.
Don't use hard borders or sharp corners for structure.
Don't make more than one surface per screen loud (the hero owns that).
Don't fetch webfonts - IBM Plex is bundled; the app is offline by design.
